dialog.missing_trans.prompt: The following mods do not have a translation file for '{0}' yet:

mod.toggle.label: Mod Status
mod.toggle.desc: Toggles the mod including all Harmony patches instantly. State is persisted.

UI_PauseGameOnMenu_Desc: Freezes game time while menu is open.
UI_UseGameLanguage_Desc: Matches the language selected in the main game.
UI_SelectLanguage_Desc: Choose your preferred language for menus and tooltips.
core.force_resume.name: Resume Game (Emergency Unpause)
core.force_resume.desc: Immediately clears any stuck loading pause reasons, unblocks input, and restores game time scale.
core.clean_memory.name: Clean Memory & VRAM Now
core.cleaner.ready_desc: Immediately releases unused textures, meshes, and frees RAM/VRAM.

core.enable_memory_cleaner.desc: Periodically purges unused assets (Resources.UnloadUnusedAssets) and triggers GC during player-imperceptible moments to fight FPS loss.
core.clean_on_fast_travel.name: Clean on Fast Travel
core.clean_on_fast_travel.desc: Automatically purge unused assets and collect memory during Fast Travel loading screens.
core.clean_on_save.name: Clean on Save
core.clean_on_save.desc: Automatically purge unused assets and collect memory when saving (Quicksave / Autosave).
core.clean_on_laptop.name: Clean on Laptop Access
core.clean_on_laptop.desc: Automatically purge unused assets and collect memory when opening the laptop / tablet computer.
core.clean_on_menu_open.name: Clean on Menu Open
core.clean_on_menu_open.desc: Automatically purge unused assets and collect memory when opening the Mod Menu.
